CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auth_user_customer_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM public.users
  WHERE id = auth.uid()
  LIMIT 1;
$function$
